events.title: Tunisia Sports Festival
events.summary: Content coverage of the first Tunisia Sports Festival at the Parc des Expositions du Kram: four days of sport, fitness, combat sports, gaming and e-sport.

Three halls: combat sports and bodybuilding, fitness and group training, gaming and e-sport
